text.en:
[Shoot]  : Hold to charge; release to fire.
This weapon's projectiles create Stasis crystals and freeze nearby targets.

Intrinsically <overload/>Anti-Overload.

Deals 25% increased damage to <stasis/>Frozen Enemies and always destroys <stasis/>Stasis Crystals on hit.

Charging this weapon makes your next shot create a triangular pattern of <stasis/>Stasis Crystals on impact with the top pointed towards you. 

<stasis/>Stasis Crystals spread outwards as one Small Crystal at the front, two Medium Crystals in the middle, then three Large Crystals in the back.
